programme.title: Christmas In July
programme.desc: It’s July on the calendar but Christmas in our hearts. Frankie whips up three summertime twists on Christmas themed dishes and serves up tips and tricks for celebrating the most wonderful time of year in July.

programme.title: We Knead Pizza

programme.title: Sweater Weather
programme.desc: The air is crisp and the leaves are changing, which means it’s time to gather ‘round the dinner table for hearty, seasonal meals on a budget. These warm dishes are sure to keep you cozy all season long.

programme.desc: At a loss when your pantry is empty? With these recipes, you can walk into any grocery store with only $7 and walk out with everything you need for an entire meal. Because yes, you can whip up a nutritious meal at an affordable price!

programme.desc: Never underestimate the power of squash: they’re affordable, abundant and they come in all shapes, sizes, colors, and textures. Frankie spotlights squash from summer through winter highlighting their amazing superhero traits.

programme.desc: Keep your pantry stocked with a few basic staples, and you’ll always have ingredients on hand for dinner, especially for pasta night. In this episode, Frankie creates delicious pasta dishes with the kitchen’s best-kept secret weapon – the pantry.

programme.title: Potatoes Gonna Potate
programme.desc: Who knew potatoes are not only affordable, but nutrient rich? Frankie is cookin’ up 3 potato dishes that are guaranteed to fill you up, and later a trio of delicious pancakes with a surprising twist.

programme.title: Summer BBQ
programme.desc: Summer is coming to a close but there’s still a bounty of fresh, seasonal produce to enjoy. Celebrate with Frankie as he makes some of his favorite cookout classics that’ll take you from a weekend picnic to a backyard BBQ, with or without a grill.

programme.title: Bring Your Own Lunch
programme.desc: Frankie is all about BYOL - bring your own lunch. It’s not only good for your wallet, it’s good for your health. Skip the vending machine and the cafeteria in favor of creative, cost effective and easy-to-transport midday meals.

programme.title: Citrus Sunshine
programme.desc: Winter citrus is here to brighten up your day. Frankie is fixing up some light, zesty, and affordable recipes to add a little seasonal sunshine to your plate.

programme.title: Suppertime Superstar
programme.desc: Whether you’re cooking for a casual weeknight or a special occasion, Frankie shared delicious and hearty dishes that will not only shine on the dinner table, but they’ll also impress your guests, without costing an arm and a leg.

programme.title: A Leftover Glowup
programme.desc: Give last week’s leftovers the makeover they deserve with Frankie’s recipes for tasty, waste-reducing meals that transform uninspiring excess food into fresh and exciting dishes. Your bank account will thank you.

programme.title: Romantic Steakhouse Dinner
programme.desc: Give your wallet a break by taking the fine-dining experience straight to the comfort of your home. From tender, juicy steak paired with classic sides, to decadent desserts, Frankie’s got your date night meal covered.

programme.title: Fancy Pants Pasta
programme.desc: This week, treat yourself to a restaurant-worthy pasta dinner at a fraction of the price, as Frankie cooks up some of his signature dishes featuring show stopping sauces.

programme.title: I Need To Eat Right Now
programme.desc: At the end of a long, hectic day, when you need dinner in a pinch, Frankie unlocks his not-so-secret formula for whipping up quick and easy meals, using minimal ingredients that will satisfy your cravings and feed the family in a flash.

programme.title: Piece Of The Pie
programme.desc: There may be infinite ways to define pie, but the only math that matters is what makes these sweet and savory dishes fit the bill. In true Struggle Style, Frankie rolls out his best tips and tricks for enjoying hassle free, cost friendly pies.

programme.title: The Big Game
programme.desc: Brackets are complete and all that’s missing is food to fuel your team’s run. Huddle around the kitchen as Frankie preps the ultimate watch party spread. These savory, spicy and sweet dishes are championship-worthy even if your bracket goes bust.

programme.title: Bananas For Bananas
programme.desc: As one of the cheapest members of the produce aisle, bananas will save you bunches of money when you whip up these delightfully appealing recipes that go above and beyond a basic bread.

programme.title: Cry Me An Allium River
programme.desc: Frankie takes on his longtime frenemy, the onion, and all its powerful relatives. There might be a few tears shed along the way, but they are well worth the delicious and flavorful results, from sweet buttery leeks to the ultimate onion masterpiece.

programme.title: 100th Episode
programme.desc: Frankie celebrates the 100th episode of Struggle Meals with a look back on memorable moments, favorite recipes, bloopers and cooking mishaps. Take a peek behind the scenes, hear from the audience, and celebrate with a special surprise guest.

programme.title: Warm + Cozy Winter
programme.desc: Frankie gets cozy in the Struggle kitchen with recipes that bring all the warmth, flavor and joy during the coldest days of winter. From a casual weekday dinner to a special weekend meal, these dishes are sure to keep you warm and cozy.

programme.title: Eggscellent Techniques
programme.desc: In this special technique episode, Frankie teaches us several methods for cooking a quintessential ingredient: eggs. The scramble, the omelet, the Benedict – learn to make them just the way you like them.

programme.title: Vintage
programme.desc: Frankie cooks his way back in time with his favorite vintage recipes. These oldie-but-goodie dishes are not only nostalgic and comforting, but they’ll also fill you up without costing you a pretty penny.

programme.title: Struggle Soup
programme.desc: Warm and hearty bowls of veggies, beans, pasta, and more, these soups will have you returning for seconds all year round. Frankie’s soup blueprints can turn everyday ingredients into extraordinary soups, with endless flavor opportunity.

programme.title: Struggle Sandwich
programme.desc: In a sandwich, every component plays a role. With a supporting cast of fixin’s, and Frankie’s cost-saving homemade twists, these sandwiches just might steal the show.

programme.title: Cabbage, cabbage, cabbage
programme.desc: Cabbage has long been an underrated green on the field, and it’s about time Frankie gives it a starring role. This leafy head proves itself as the versatile ingredient we need it to be, affordable year around, delicious and filling.

programme.title: Mayo: The Secret Ingredient
programme.desc: Who knew mayo could be such a savvy secret agent? It’s a controversial condiment that can unlock the buttery, crispy, decadent codes of our favorite dishes, without leaving a trace of mayo-ness. Best of all, it’s easy to make at home!

programme.title: Crunchy
programme.desc: Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget.

programme.title: A Cruciferous Delicious Time
programme.desc: No veggie family packs the same nutritious punch as the cruciferous family, and with a shelf life this long, they’ve become a fixture in Frankie’s meal rotation. These delicious and easy-to-make recipes will win everyone over in no time.

programme.title: 5-Ingredient Recipes
programme.desc: Who said struggle meals can’t be delicious? Don’t sleep on these 5-ingredient recipes – simple weeknight meals that are anything but boring, and with a few pantry staples, you’ll have dinner on the table in no time.

programme.title: Homemade-ish
programme.desc: Last minute company leaving you in a pinch? Frankie has you covered with these easy recipes featuring store bought staples. With a few Struggle tips, these basic ingredients can be transformed into dishes that will impress your guests.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep18

Bagaimanapun Ainnura enggan kerana tidak mahu Fariz dianggap sebagai anak derhaka. Gara-hara terlalu marah dengan Ainnura, Rohana telah menghentak kepala Ainnura ke dinding. Fariz perasan dengan bengkak di kepala Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep19
programme.desc: Ainnura berbohong dengan Fariz yang bengkak di kepalanya akiat terhantuk pada sinki. Dalam waktu yang sama, Rohana mendakwa Ainnura sengaja menolaknya sehinggakan dia hampir terjatuh. Fateha menyokong kata-kata Rohana, menyebabkan Fariz keliru siapakah yang benar di antara isteri dan ibunya. Ainnura bangkit mempertahankan haknya. Selain daripada Ainnura, Fawwaz turut menjadi mangsa Rohana dan Fateha dengan pelbagai penghinaan sehingga akhirnya kerana tidak sanggup melihat Fawwaz dihina, Fazira mengakui yang Fawwaz adalah anaknya.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep20
programme.desc: Fateha dan Rohana terkejut apabila mengetahui Fawwaz adalah anak Fazira hasil hubungan terlarang dengan Raja Azali iaitu kekasih Fateha. Pada mulanya mereka tidak percaya tetapi ketika mereka hendak mendapatkan penjelasan daripada Raja Azali, Raja Azali telah ditangkap polis atas beberapa tuduhan merogol. Fariz meminta maaf di atas sikap Rohana selama ini. Ainnura telah lama memaafkan Rohana tetapi mahu Fariz menceraikannya kerana dia tidak mahu Fariz menjadi anak derhaka gara-garanya. Rohana terharu dengan sikap baik Ainnura dan merayu kemaafan daripada Ainnura.

Ainnura serba salah kerana dia tahu yang Datuk Rashid mahu menjodohkan Fariz dengan anaknya, Rania. Dalam waktu yang sama, Datuk Rashid juga cuba mengeratkan hubungan Ainnura dengan Reza.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep12
programme.desc: Tok Wan kurang senang apabila mengetahui Ainnura menjalin semula hubungan dengan Fariz. Dia mahu Ainnura putuskan hubungan dengan Fariz. Justeru, Tok Wan menyokong usaha Ilah untuk menjodohkan Ainnura dengan pemuda pilihan Ilah. Demi cintanya pada Ainnura, Fariz saggup berdepan dengan Tok Wan dalam usaha merayu Tok Wan agar merestui hubungan mereka berdua sebagaimana yang pernah Tok Wan lakukan enam tahun lalu.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep13
programme.desc: Rania cuba menarik perhatian Fariz tetapi usahanya sia-sia. Akhirnya Rania menyerah kalah dan yakin cinta Fariz bukan miliknya. Bagaimanapun Datuk Rashid mendesak Rania supaya usaha lagi dan jangan mudah mengaku kalah. Dia mahu Fariz menjadi menantunya demi legasi syarikat mereka. Sementara itu, kesungguhan Fariz untuk mendapatkan semula Ainnura telah melembutkan hati Tok Wan. Dalam usaha membantu Fariz, Tok Wan sengaja merancangkan sesuatu untuk merapatkan hubungan Fariz dengan Ainnura dan Fawwaz.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep14
programme.desc: Tindakan Tok Wan merapatkan hubungan Ainnura dengan Fariz menimbulkan kemarahan Ilah. Ilah tetap berkeras untuk jodohkan Ainnura dengan lelaki pilihannya. Apabila Ainnura tidak setuju dengan pilihan Ilah, Tok Wan sengaja membuat dalih untuk kahwinkan Ainnura dengan Aidel iaitu kawan rapat Ainnura, bukannya dengan Fariz. Sementara itu, Rohana sudah membayangkan akan bermenantukan anak Datuk apabila Datuk Rashid menjemputnya mereka makan tengah hari sambil berbincang dengan perkahwinan Rania dengan Fariz.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep15
programme.desc: Ainnura akhirnya bersedia untuk berkahwin dengan Fariz untuk kali kedua tetapi memberi syarat supaya Rohana sendiri yang meminangnya. Fariz juga tidak dibenarkan mempersoalkan siapa Fawwaz yang sebenarnya kerana Fawwaz bukan anak kandung Fariz sebagaimana yang disangkakan oleh Fariz. Beberapa hari sebelum pernikahan Ainnura dan Fariz, Tok Wan meninggal dunia akibat terjatuh di bilik air.

programme.desc: Iman dipaksa berkahwin dengan Qaseh, anak kepada orang gajinya untuk mewarisi harta bapanya. Percutian mereka di Bosnia membuahkan bibit-bibit cinta. Lakonan Iqram Dinzly, Zarina Zainoordin dan Yana Shamsudin.

programme.title: Jula Juli Bintang Putus Cinta
programme.desc: Telemovie sekuel Jula Juli Bintang Cinta kini kembali! Kali ini, Jula dan Juli mengalami konflik percintaan dengan Dani & Izham sehingga mereka memutuskan untuk berpisah dan melarikan diri ke kampung Juli.

programme.title: Kampung Kuala Lambat
programme.desc: Kampung Kuala Lambat bagai mengalami sumpahan apabila lelaki yang berkahwin muda akan mati di hari pernikahan mereka namun kejadian ganjil ini tidak berlaku kepada lelaki yang berusia 60 tahun ke atas.

programme.title: Musnahkan Pelamin Anganku
programme.desc: Mikael yang merupakan seorang wedding planner menerima tawaran besar untuk menjayakan sebuah majlis perkahwinan pelanggannya. Namun majlis perkahwinan tersebut merupakan majlis bekas isterinya.

programme.title: Dua
programme.desc: Kisah Farhan yang kehilangan kembarnya Fahrin dalam satu kemalangan tragis. Dia kemudiannya mengambil-alih kehidupan Fahrin namun terperangkap dalam sebuah cinta tiga segi pula. Lakonan Eusoff Hashim dan Sharifah Sakinah.

programme.title: Racun Menantu
programme.desc: After marrying Zain, Sara lived in the same house with Pak Dolah, her father-in-law. Because of the family's grudge, Sara started making trouble by seducing her own father-in-law.

programme.title: Cupid
programme.desc: Kisah mengenai seorang ejen yang bekerja di sebuah syarikat penghancur jodoh yang ditugaskan untuk memikat seorang wanita supaya dapat melupakan suaminya yang telah diisytiharkan meninggal dunia. Namun dia jatuh cinta pada wanita tersebut

programme.title: Cerai
programme.desc: Pengalaman berkurung dengan pasangan selama musim PKP memaksa dua pasangan suami isteri menilai semula perkahwinan mereka yang telah disalah ertikan selama ini.

programme.title: Hingga Jumpa Lagi
programme.desc: Eva is diagnosed with cancer and prays that she could travel back to the past in order to prevent the love between her and her husband so that her husband can lead a happy life. Her prayer is granted…

programme.title: I Heart You Cik Yah
programme.desc: Zulkefli and Badariah are always arguing, but in order to prevent the factory where they work from being closed by Qarina, they must work together. Out of hatred, they start feeling for each other.

programme.title: Jihan Nak Displin Anak
programme.desc: Jihan dan suami kalut apabila anak mereka tidak mahu pulang beraya di kampung. Mereka cuba untuk mendisiplinkan anak mereka sebelum hari raya

programme.title: Satu Kampung Dua Orang
programme.desc: Selepas banjir besar melanda, semua penduduk kampung berpindah kerana kampung mereka tidak lagi selamat. Hanya dua beradik yang enggan berpindah atas sebab dan alasan mereka tersendiri.

programme.title: Jamil Balik Kampung
programme.desc: Kisah perjalanan Jamil pulang ke kampung untuk meminang kekasihnya setelah pinangannya pernah ditolak beberapa kali. Berjayakah misi Jamil kali ini?

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am
programme.desc: We’ll be back at 6.00am

programme.title: Sampai Nanti
programme.desc: Kyle dan Milly bertemu kembali setelah 10 tahun terpisah dan cinta lama kembali terjalin. Tetapi adakah cinta mereka akan terus kekal hingga ke akhirnya?

programme.title: Asam Pedas Cendol Sejoli
programme.desc: Karim adalah pemilik kedai cendol bersebelahan dengan kedai asam pedas Kalsom. Mereka bermusuhan, tetapi anak mereka – Kinah dan Khalil – mencintai satu sama lain, dan terpaksa menyembunyikan perkara ini bagi mengelakkan perang antara dua kedai mereka.

programme.title: Tolong Saya Encik Dinosaur
programme.desc: Elly berpindah dari bandar ke pekan kecil untuk mencari ketenangan. Tetapi kenangan buruk tetap menghantui dirinya, sehinggalah dia bertemu dengan Karl yang mengajarnya erti sebuah kebahagiaan.

programme.title: Cubit - Cubit Cinta
programme.desc: Kupid Cubit is a dating app that enables the masses to find love. But for Katarina and Saiful, it's a platform for healing people with unrequited love.

programme.title: Duit Kawin
programme.desc: Memaparkan pemikiran remaja sekarang terhadap perkahwinan dari sudut kos atas syariat agama tetapi tertekan cara hidup zaman kini yang mahukan kemewahan.

programme.title: Biarkan Cinta Tersenyum Lagi
programme.desc: Kisah penulis lagu Maya Arisa yang menghidap tumor otak dan mengimpikan untuk berkahwin. Dia kemudiannya bertemu dengan seorang jurugambar bernama Redza.

programme.title: Ayat Dari Langit
programme.desc: Ustaz Muiz dan isterinya mengajar ajaran sesat dan mahu pengikutnya mengikut telunjuk mereka yang lama kelamaan mula membuatkan pengikutnya bernama Kamal mula merasa sangsi.

programme.title: Cinta Round 1
programme.desc: Farid is a nerdy guy who always been bullied by Syakirin, his senior. Farid determined to enter an MMA tournament organized by their university so to put an end to being bullied by Syakirin.

programme.title: Racun Suami Jahanam
programme.desc: Suraya is a naive village girl who looks forward to happy days when Hazrul proposes to her. But those happy days are only temporary when she learns who Hazrul really is.

programme.title: 6 Hari
programme.desc: Suzi is content with being a third wife and living alone in her bungalow as she only entertains her husband every 6 days. Everything comes crashing when a person from her past returns to her life.

programme.title: Please Subscribe Cintaku
programme.desc: Hannah and her friend Alia have gone to an abandoned construction site to find material for her YouTube channel, but she unknowingly records a murder.

programme.title: Diva Dari Jakarta
programme.desc: Erin dan Ejot sering dibandingkan dari segi paras rupa. Sehingga suatu hari sesuatu telah berlaku kepada Erin yang mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Diam Tanda Setuju
programme.desc: Kisah dua sahabat baik yang berhadapan dengan konflik perhubungan di saat mereka mula panik memikirkan usia mereka yang semakin meningkat tetapi belum bertemu jodoh.

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am
programme.desc: We’ll be back at 6.00am

programme.title: Nasiya
programme.desc: Ketika melarikan diri dari bekas suaminya, Ihyana telah mengalami kemalangan tetapi dia bernasib baik kerana telah diselamatkan oleh satu entiti luar biasa yang telah mengubah kelakuannya.

programme.title: Suamiku Encik Beruang
programme.desc: Ani, the most beautiful girl in the village, who is ever man's fantasy, decides to marry Mr. Bear as her husband, much to everyone's surprise. As for the chief village, he intend to organise the "wedding of the year".

programme.title: Menanti Hari Itu
programme.desc: Kisah kasih sayang seorang ibu terhadap anak kandungnya yang tidak pernah terpadam meskipun si anak menjauhkan diri akibat hasutan keluarga angkatnya sendiri.

programme.title: Kecundang Sebelum Menjanda
programme.desc: Hari terbahagia dalam hidup Nora berubah menjadi suram bila tunangnya menarik diri pada hari pernikahan mereka. Tambah buruk lagi, hari selepas tragedi itu asyik berulang atas sebab-sebab misteri.

programme.title: Aku Raja Lawak
programme.desc: Silah nak jadi pelawak yang terkenal, cuma di kampungnya tak ada peluang pekerjaan pelawak sepenuh masa. Tapi dia tetap mendapat sokongan padu daripada peminat nombor satunya – iaitu Faris, anaknya.

programme.title: Bayangan Emilia
programme.desc: Rita berpindah masuk ke banglo Ungku Mahmud dan mula merasai akan kehadiran roh yang seperti tidak senang dengan kehadirannya disitu. Apakah misteri di sebalik rumah banglo tersebut?

programme.title: Oh Speak English Please
programme.desc: Kisah Sally anak remaja moden yang merasa malu dengan ibunya kerana tidak pandai berbahasa Inggeris dan berketrampilan agak kekampungan. Lakonan Rozita Che Wan dan Zahirah MacWilson.

programme.title: Striker Hati Ayah
programme.desc: Sofia susah untuk memilih antara dua calon, Raf atau Noah. Lalu meminta pendapat ayahnya, Adam. Kini dua lelaki tersebut terpaksa memenangi hati ayah Sofia, seorang peminat fanatik bola.

programme.title: Gebu Gebu Manis
programme.desc: Kisah Hamdi dan Dolah yang memulakan perniagaan dodol tetapi sering disabotaj oleh Amira yang cemburu dengan perniagaan dua orang sahabat ini.

programme.title: Perangkap Perkahwinan
programme.desc: Three best friends promised to get married, at the same time when they turn 26 years old. Their perceptions of marriage life begin to change and conflict ensues.

programme.title: Cik Puan Sinderella
programme.desc: This is a lighthearted family drama about a teenage girl who is closely guarded by her mother.

programme.desc: Dachshund, prince of the dog world and American pitbull, the gangster boss compete to see who is the cutest? There are many problems when taking your dog out for a walk, pet trainer teaches your dog to walk well in 3 steps! What are the precautions for daily care of dogs dog owners are most concerned about? Remember to deworm regularly to give them a fullout protection! Let's make a nutritious fresh pet food cake together! Tainan’s first leisure farm designed specifically for pets, keep your furry friends entertained through spring outings and play in the water!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: This week finds Dr. Matt grappling with wild cats, a juvenile delinquent donkey, too many male lemurs and a penguin with a eye problem.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Because of her love for cats, Claire carefully created a place called "There is a Cat at the Corner". While enjoying your meals and drinks, more than a dozen beautiful cats are strolling freely in the store, waiting to interact with you up close and enjoy a slow life with you. However, if you want to pet the cat yourself and win their favor, you must first understand the nature and preferences of cats! Claire also generously shares her "experiences in ruling over dozens of cats", which is extremely precious. Novice cat lovers should come and have a look!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: we'll be seeing the best penguin fails, p-p-p-party penguins, we'll get up close and personal with wild animals, and we'll go on safari. we'll also meet angry animals living the thug life, some crazy critters, and we'll watch sporty animals in action.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Join us at the Dog Rescuers house as host Alan Davies throws the ultimate Christmas party for his doggy friends. This year's Dog Rescuers Christmas Special follows Inspector Lauren Bailey as she journeys to Lapland on an arctic adventure to discover how one winter wonderland dog sled organisation is blazing a trail for the welfare of working Husky Dogs.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt tries to perk up Spike the iguana who's down in the dumps and he meets the latest fascinating additions to the aquarium the magical but very endangered seahorses. But he also faces every vet's nightmare during an operation on a budgie.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've scoured the internet to bring you the most hilarious clips of Budgies (and other birds) on the planet, not so much -§who's a clever boy-¨ as -§who's a funny boy-¨! Flying fails, performing Parrots and the real life angry birds -V we've assembled the very best the web has to offer, guaranteed to make you laugh out loud.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.desc: From Christmas as you've never experienced it before, with out-of-tune carol singers, Santa getting stuck, ungrateful children and exploding Christmas puddings - to OAP's, kids and even blundering burglars, six brand spanking new topics are given the trademark LOL treatment, combining user-generated footage with comic narration by comedian Iain Lee. There's a treat too for animal lovers with a Puppies special featuring some of the cutest, as well as funniest, puppy clips on the web.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Baxter is a Shih-Tzu that was discovered abandoned in an empty house on the outskirts of Manchester; thin and with extremely matted fur. Inspector Lyndsey Taylor comes to the rescue, but until all that fur is removed, nobody knows what lies beneath.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The era of high housing prices shocks the masses. However, some are willing to live in the mountains for their beloved parrots, just to give them the best breeding environment. Parrots have a long lifespan and their IQ is comparable to that of a five-year-old child. How do you make them behave? Training is actually a good way, but how? "Melon seeds" are key to the goal. If you want to raise a parrot, there are in fact many restrictions on choosing the right one. How should I put it? Don’t miss "Cute Pet Guide"!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt treats a springer spaniel with a footballer's knee injury, and unblocks the nostrils of an African Grey parrot called Rosie and fights to save the life of a sparrowhawk which has been hit by a car.

programme.title: Scruffts

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.desc: After planning a perfect heist, Nick is ready to score. One problem, his girl and the crew, have other ideas. They take Nick down in a hail of bullets but Nick doesn't die and in a race for his life, seeks revenge one target at a time.

programme.title: High Voltage
programme.desc: After a lightning strike kills the lead singer of a band, she is resurrected with electrifying special abilities.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - Serena's Game
programme.desc: Refusing to comply with Tommy’s demands, Max and Paul conspire to have the British gangster eliminated and Serena arrested. With Tommy dead and Serena in handcuffs, it appears as though Max has succeeded. His plan goes awry, however, when MI6 force Max to help Serena bring down her employers: the Russian mob. Torn between a life of crime with Serena or happiness with Ava, nothing is ever simple in the life of Max Mayfair.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: A deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy, the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.title: Mayfair - Shooting Paul
programme.desc: Hoping to put the past behind him and go legit, Max is persuaded by Paul to open a new Mister Mayfair club in Portugal. Conflict, however, seems to follow Max wherever he goes. Drawn into a violent turf war between London Gangsters and the Italian Mafia, his relationship with Ava is jeopardised by the arrival of his former flame, Serena. Max’s carefully crafted world seems to be collapsing around him. With his family’s lives on the line, Max is blackmailed by British crime boss, Tommy, to assassinate his best friend, Paul.

programme.title: Enter The Clones of Bruce
programme.desc: Enter the Clones of Bruce dives into the Bruce Lee exploitation craze, otherwise known as Bruceploitation.

programme.title: Hideout
programme.desc: Evading police at a remote farmhouse after fumbling a robbery, four criminals discover that the family living there is not who they appear to be.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: Broadcast
programme.desc: After a billionaire creates a drug called INOC which stops the aging process, the future of a world where death no longer exists is seen. The story of the fate of mankind is told while also revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Ep03 Roz kembali beraksi setelah lama bersara, dengan bantuan Ejen Mah. Dia sampai ke lokasi yang disangkakan Rin ada di situ, malangnya pihak polis dan Daniel juga sampai ke situ. Daniel menyerang Roz kerana dia sangka Roz adalah penculik. Roz cuba melindungi identitinya sebagai seorang perisik.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Ep04 Roz, Datin Seri dan Ejen Mah kembali beraksi untuk menolong Roz menyelamatkan cucunya, Rin. Mereka dapat mengesan lokasi sebenar Rin dan menyelamatkannya sebelum Daniel dan polis tiba. Rin kini tahu identiti sebenar Opah Roz.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep5
programme.desc: Ep05 Kegembiraan Roz dapat menyelamatkan Rin terbantut apabila penculik Rin telah melepaskan diri daripada tahanan polis. Roz juga mengaitkan kes penculikan Rin dengan kes Dr Kaos Jr yang terlepas dari penjara dengan rancangan jahat yang lebih besar.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep6
programme.desc: Ep06 Roz dan Rin diserang. Dia menjejak para penyerangnya ke pangkalan rahsia mereka. Ejen Mah dihantar untuk menyiasat tetapi dia ditangkap. Roz, Datin Seri dan Rin bekerjasama membebaskan Ejen Mah dan Roz dapat mengalahkan Nora, ketua penculik. Tetapi Dr Kaos Jr telah maju selangkah dan bereksperimen dengan senjata barunya.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep7
programme.desc: Ep07 Daniel marah kerana pembanteras jenayah melalkukan kerja polis dengan menangkap penjenayah-penjenayah. Tanpa dia ketahui itu adalah kerja ibunya sendiri. Sementara itu, Roz ditangkap oleh Dr Kaos Jr. Datin Seri menyelamatkan Roz dan mereka dapat maklumat nama ketua penjahat yang merancang semua kejahatan ini.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Ep03 Roz kembali beraksi setelah lama bersara, dengan bantuan Ejen Mah. Dia sampai ke lokasi yang disangkakan Rin ada di situ, malangnya pihak polis dan Daniel juga sampai ke situ. programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Ep04 Roz, Datin Seri dan Ejen Mah kembali beraksi untuk menolong Roz menyelamatkan cucunya, Rin. Mereka dapat mengesan lokasi sebenar Rin dan menyelamatkannya sebelum Daniel dan polis tiba. Rin kini tahu identiti sebenar Opah Roz.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep5
programme.desc: Ep05 Kegembiraan Roz dapat menyelamatkan Rin terbantut apabila penculik Rin telah melepaskan diri daripada tahanan polis. Roz juga mengaitkan kes penculikan Rin dengan kes Dr Kaos Jr yang terlepas dari penjara dengan rancangan jahat yang lebih besar.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep6
programme.desc: Ep06 Roz dan Rin diserang. Dia menjejak para penyerangnya ke pangkalan rahsia mereka. Ejen Mah dihantar untuk menyiasat tetapi dia ditangkap. Roz, Datin Seri dan Rin bekerjasama membebaskan Ejen Mah dan Roz dapat mengalahkan Nora, ketua penculik. Tetapi Dr Kaos Jr telah maju selangkah dan bereksperimen dengan senjata barunya.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep7
programme.desc: Ep07 Daniel marah kerana pembanteras jenayah melalkukan kerja polis dengan menangkap penjenayah-penjenayah. Tanpa dia ketahui itu adalah kerja ibunya sendiri. Sementara itu, Roz ditangkap oleh Dr Kaos Jr. Datin Seri menyelamatkan Roz dan mereka dapat maklumat nama ketua penjahat yang merancang semua kejahatan ini.

programme.desc: Ivan está investigando el comercio ilegal de carne de caza en Kinshasa, cuando se topa con tres crías de chimpancé cautivas que se venden en el mercado negro. Se planea un dramático rescate en el que los chimpancés son entregados sanos y salvos a un lugar dedicado a proporcionar un futuro mejor a todos los primates de África.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E01 - Koala
programme.desc: This series is a unique look at the early life and development of young animals, edited and narrated from the viewpoint of the animal's themselves. As children explore the wonders of animal life, their natural fascination will deepen into a true love and appreciation of animals. In the first episode we meet Koala.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E02 - Gazelle
programme.desc: We gazelles live on the Savannah in Africa. Mummy said, that the Savannah is a very dry place. My dad has big horns so he can fight to protect us because lions want to eat us. We must be careful even by the river because crocodiles are watching. We eat mainly dry grass and if its not too dry we don’t need to drink much.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E03 - Sea Lion
programme.desc: We live in the ocean! It’s huge and wet. But mainly we live on the ocean shore. That’s where all the seal families make their home. What we love the most is swimming! Water is the greatest fun in the world. We have no problem staying in the water for hours at a time. Together with dolphins, we love to jump into the waves. Look at us go! Isn’t that awesome?

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E04 - Brumby
programme.desc: I am a wild horse who lives in Australia. We were born to run and the difference between me and a farm horse is that I can run freely where I want. I meet with my friends the donkeys and lizards at waterholes which are very precious for us. But watch out! We don’t like to be pushed around or feel threatened.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E05 - Butterfly
programme.desc: We Monarch Butterflies have to chew our way from our egg to see the world. Bite by bite together, with my brothers and sisters we start to feed on the leaves. We don’t have any parents but just know what to do. When we feel cold, hungry, or afraid, we feel the same way as you do. We travel a lot and are capable of eating much more than our own weight. Our life is definitely hard work.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E06 - Pelican
programme.desc: There are many pelicans in the world. We are Australian pelicans. But we don’t live only in Australia. We also live in other parts of the world. Pelicans like to hunt together. We hunt as a team. We swim in the water in a flock making noise with our feet and wings, that's how we drive the fish into shallows where we easily catch them. Flying is very easy for us and our nests are built from grass stems.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E07 - Elephant
programme.desc: Unsere Heimat ist Afrika und wir haben auch Verwandte in Indien. Aber das hier ist Afrika. Wir haben viele Freunde, die hier mit uns leben. Seht ihr? Gazellen, Antilopen, Gnus....sie alle fressen nur, was aus dem Boden wächst. Elefanten lieben es, im Wasser und im Schlamm zu spielen. Wir werfen den Schlamm umher und spritzen uns das Wasser über den ganzen Körper. Aber pass auf! Wir wollen nicht auf die Löwen treffen.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E08 - Tern
programme.desc: We live by the water and build our nests in the sand on the shores. We like to live all together in a flock. We terns are able to fly soooooooo long above the ocean without landing. If we don’t need to, we might not land at all. Flying is a blast! There are lots of different subspecies of tern. And we’re going to visit some of them today. We are all related. It’s kind of like being in a big family.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E09 - Ants
programme.desc: I’m a Green Tree Ant and I mainly live in the forests of Australia. We ants are incredibly strong, built for working hard and long. We must all work within the community to survive. We don’t do anything just for fun and we always think about all the other ants and what is good for us all. We have to fight together for our place in the forest and to protect the most important ant in our community which is our queen.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E10 - Sea Horse
programme.desc: In the seahorse family, it is the daddy who gives birth to us. He carry’s us in his sac, until we hatch from the eggs our mommy lay into his sac. There are various species of seahorse. That’s why we come in different sizes and shapes. Some live bound to the corals, because the marine currents are very strong. We love exploring the waters we live in.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E11 - Bear
programme.desc: We bears live a solitary life but when it comes to hunting we take it as a reunion. We love to catch and eat fish in the river where we spend a lot of our time but the forest is also our home. We have a lot of animal neighbours such as buffalos, seagulls, coyotes but we never really like to meet with wolves. Everyone is a bit different, because everyone lives differently. That’s why it is better not mingle with others and stay with your own kind.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E12 - Budgie
programme.desc: We budgies live in Australia. Here you’ll find everything that budgerigars need: open and broad plains; lakes; rivers; and mainly thousands and thousands of budgerigar friends. I don’t know, but it’s a beautiful life. I like it. Eating grass seeds and chatting with our other beautiful friends makes me happy.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E13 - Cat
programme.desc: Wild cats and domestic cats are all born the same way but their way of life is a bit different. Wild cats eat what they catch. But domestic cats get food from humans. Domestic cats don’t have to hunt anymore. This wild cat lives all alone. She must find some hideout against bad weather and predators without any help. Domestic cats like the presence of human and a comfortable home. What is better?

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E14 - Dingo
programme.desc: Hello, I’m little dingo and my mummy will tell me the story of how I was born and how I live. Here we go - Once upon a time, in a country far, far away, called Australia......a huge and mysterious bird brought the soul of a little dingo down to the Earth......into his mummy’s tummy... and how did it continue? Listen to the whole story.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E15 - Clownfish
programme.desc: I love swimming around and playing in the waters of our tropical ocean. There is so much to explore and many colours and shapes. We live in the Sea Anemone and have a glossy coat. The Clown Fish has only three stripes on an orange body but some of our relatives have lots of stripes. Sometimes I like to look at the other fish but I think that the striped ones are the prettiest.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E16 - Cheetah
programme.desc: We are the fastest runners in the world. We hunt our dinner and when we do we can run only for a short distance, we must catch something fast; otherwise we have to stop. If we don’t stop we can overheat, and that’s a very dangerous condition for us. We also have an extra claw called an dew claw. When we’re chasing down a prey, we hook this claw around their legs to topple them over. We can do this running at our top speed. Cheetahs are recognizable by our black spots and they sure do suit us.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E17 - Crocodile
programme.desc: I am an alligator. No, not a crocodile - an alligator. When I got out of my egg I found myself in Australia which is the place where some of the biggest crocodiles in the world live. But they also live in other parts of the world too. And why are people afraid of crocodiles? Find out for yourself.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E18 - Echidna
programme.desc: Hello - I'm an echidna - some people call us spiny anteaters. When I was born I came out of my Mum's pouch. No, my spines didn't hurt her because I hatched from an egg and she kept me warm inside her pouch until I was ready to come out. It takes many days and nights, but a little echidna doesn’t really notice the time passing, because it’s hidden away. Whilst waiting Mum will dig a nursery den in the ground, into which she’ll put her growing baby and once the baby is fully developed it can go explore the world. Adventures await!

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E19 - Kangaroo
programme.desc: We love our home in Australia. We love all types of grass, but there are some types we prefer more. Oh did I mention we love to jump? Every part of a kangaroo’s body is perfectly suited for skillful jumping. What is also special about us is that when we are small our mom carries us in her pouch isn’t that cool?

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E20 - Kestrel
programme.desc: Hello! I’m a kestrel and I’ve a got a great view from our nest. My mummy is flying around here, somewhere. Kestrels are predators, which mean we eat meat. But we only hunt for things that are smaller than us – like voles, mice, and even some insects. We settle in hollow trees or something similar and lay our eggs. From that point, it takes less than a month for us little kestrels to hatch.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E21 - Turtle
programme.desc: Turtle Mum usually just lays her eggs and leaves. Once we hatch, we have to take care of ourselves. From the moment we hatch, we know everything we need to know. We know what to do, where the ocean is, how to swim, and how to walk. Our goal is to get into the water. In the ocean, we are agile, and great swimmers. We’re better at swimming than crawling around on land.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E22 - Zebra
programme.desc: Hello I’m a little zebra. You say you already know about me? I live in Africa. It’s nice and warm here, I like it a lot. Also, other animals live here with us and there is always something exciting going on. We are black and white and have stripes. When we come to waterholes we must be careful not to meet the crocodile because he would want to eat us. Even when there are a lot of us, we still walk together. We love to roll in the dust!

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E23 - My Friends From the Air
programme.desc: There are many birds in the world. You can hear their chattering, singing, cawing, and cackling across every continent. Do you think they will ever learn how to sing properly? And there are so many! Why don’t they ever crash? Lets learn more about our bird friends!

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E24 - My Friends From Water
programme.desc: Take a deep breath and let’s go under water. There are so many things and creatures to explore. There are all sorts of shapes and colours, and different ways of life. Each living thing: Humans and animals on dry land, fish living in water, birds, plants, and even insects - are all different. But most of us have three things in common: we breathe oxygen, eat, and breed. Let's look at some of our water animal friends.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E25 - My Friends From Savannah
programme.desc: A new day has begun on the savannah. Herds of gazelle, antelope, zebra, and all kinds of other animals move around to find fresh areas to graze. There are many species of animals living in Africa. They live on the seemingly endless plains of the savannah. Many animals you know from the zoo, live here in the wild. These wild animals like their freedom. They don’t need us to take care of them. They live freely in the wilderness.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E26 - My Best Friends
programme.desc: Today we will remind everyone of what we’ve learned in all the previous episodes, about the different lives of our animal friends. They are all here. The koala, turtle, cheetah, crocodile, bear, zebra and the butterfly...what do you remember about them?

programme.desc: 100 years in 100 minutes

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E15 - Clownfish

The Clown Fish has only three stripes on an orange body but some of our relatives have lots of stripes. Sometimes I like to look at the other fish but I think that the striped ones are the prettiest.

programme.title: My Animal Friends - S01:E16 - Cheetah
programme.desc: We are the fastest runners in the world. We hunt our dinner and when we do we can run only for a short distance, we must catch something fast; otherwise we have to stop. If we don’t stop we can overheat, and that’s a very dangerous condition for us. We also have an extra claw called an dew claw. When we’re chasing down a prey, we hook this claw around their legs to topple them over. We can do this running at our top speed. Cheetahs are recognizable by our black spots and they sure do suit us.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E06 - Now or Never
programme.desc: Con los ánimos levantados, los hermanos Keefer se disponen a avistar y acechar una manada de caribúes cercana, pero acercarse resulta más difícil de lo esperado.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E07 - Cache Out
programme.desc: Con la carne roja, los hermanos Keefer consiguen por fin reponer sus agotadas energías, pero no son los únicos que buscan sobrevivir al invierno en las tierras salvajes de Alaska.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E08 - Bearing Down
programme.desc: La dura realidad del invierno se impone, y los hermanos Keefer se ven obligados a dormir con un ojo abierto mientras un oso pardo patrulla los alrededores de su campamento.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E09 - Head to Head
programme.desc: Con la tormenta ártica pisándoles los talones, los hermanos Keefer corren río abajo para llegar a su siguiente depósito de suministros, pero se pierden cuando el río se divide en un laberinto de pequeños canales.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E10 - Edge of the Storm
programme.desc: Cuando las temperaturas caen en picado, los hermanos Keefer se abren paso río abajo a través de aguas heladas y fuertes vientos en contra con la esperanza de llegar al lugar de extracción antes de que la tormenta ártica lo reclame.

programme.title: Survival Science - - S01:E03 - Surviving a Bear Attack
programme.desc: Nick y Laura ponen a prueba la potencia y velocidad de los osos pardos utilizando herramientas de acróbatas de Hollywood para experimentar un ataque. Además: un intento de recrear el disparo de una flecha que salvó a un hombre del ataque de un oso.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E04 - Surviving a Mountain Lion Attack
programme.desc: Laura y Nick desmenuzan los comportamientos, la fuerza, la vista y la velocidad de los pumas mediante experimentos y exploran técnicas para hacer frente a estos depredadores ápice.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E05 - Surviving a Lightning Strike
programme.desc: Laura y Nick determinan el poder que tienen los rayos y cómo se comportan en un Laboratorio de Pruebas de Rayos de Efectos Directos de última generación. Ofrecen consejos a cazadores y pescadores para protegerse de ellos.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E06 - ATV Accidents
programme.desc: Laura y Nick preparan unas espectaculares pruebas de ATV a alta velocidad para ver cómo se producen los accidentes y qué hacer para protegerse de los daños.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E07 - Treestand Accidents
programme.desc: Explorando por qué ocurren los accidentes de treestand y cómo prevenirlos.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S01:E02 - C.J. Wickersham Story
programme.desc: En este episodio de Lucha por sobrevivir escuchamos la desgarradora historia de C.J. Wickersham que luchará por sobrevivir al ataque de un tiburón mientras pescaba con arpón.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S01:E03 - Jamey Mosch
